title: A table inside a story
concept: A <Table> rides on a paragraph: HeaderRowCount/BodyRowCount and ColumnCount set the grid, Row/Column give the tracks, and each Cell (Name="col:row") holds its own paragraph.

annotations.note: The Table sits inside a CharacterStyleRange, which is inside a ParagraphStyleRange — it rides on a host paragraph. HeaderRowCount=1 + BodyRowCount=2 means three rows; ColumnCount=2 means two columns.
One <Row> per row; Name is the zero-based row index, SingleRowHeight the row's height in points.
One <Column> per column; Name is the zero-based column index, SingleColumnWidth the column's width in points.
A <Cell> addresses its grid position with Name="col:row" (zero-indexed). This is cell 0:0 — column 0, the header row. RowSpan/ColumnSpan default to 1.
FillColor paints the cell background; the header cells fill Black. The four TextInsets pad the cell content from its edges.
The cell's content is an ordinary ParagraphStyleRange — a paragraph that lives inside the cell, not in the story body.
